blocks.text: A graduate from the Cagayan State University (CSU) - Tuguegarao has been named topnotcher of the November 2026 Agricultural and Biosystems Engineers Licensure Examination by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).
Kaerol Pacallagan Zamora garnered a percentage score of 94.36, the highest among 2,375 engineers who successfully hurdled the examination.
